headline: Onyxia in 3:30 with no deaths

also.text: the most healing, 48k, and 3 Flame Lashes dispelled

overview: One pull, 3:30 against a usual 4:29, no deaths. Fears hit 1.7 per raider against a usual 2.6; lava cracks were about the usual rate.

wentWell.text: No deaths, and a parse median of 72 against a usual 58.

notes.text: 3:30 (median 4:29), no deaths. Alanakos parse 96, Wrenn 95, Donatelios 93.
Lava cracks hit 17 raiders 28 times; Barnstoker, Macharius and Paidwithbeer took 3 each.
